nodes.label: market_regime_classification.data
nodes.rationale: Provides the synthetic generator plus yfinance and CSV price loaders used by all sources.

nodes.label: Synthetic Market Generator
nodes.rationale: Generates a synthetic market with known latent regimes as a sanity check; it is not evidence about real markets.

nodes.label: Adjusted Rand Index
nodes.rationale: Pairwise agreement measure between detectors; on synthetic data ARI against latent states is only ~0.1-0.3 because trailing features must lag regime switches.

nodes.label: Causal Forward Filtering
nodes.rationale: Forward recursion consumes observations only up to time t, guaranteeing no future data leaks into regime probabilities.

nodes.label: Causality Test
nodes.rationale: Test verifying that truncating future rows does not change past regime probabilities.

nodes.label: market_regime_classification.detectors
nodes.rationale: Implements vol-threshold, GMM and causal Gaussian HMM, running its own forward recursion so it only consumes data up to t.

nodes.label: Economic Scorecard
nodes.rationale: Shared diagnostic across all detectors and buy & hold, reporting regime stats and risk-adjusted economic results rather than classification accuracy.

nodes.label: Regime-Conditional Forward Volatility and Return Separation
nodes.norm_label: regime-conditional forward volatility and return separation
nodes.rationale: Forward 21-day realized volatility and return by regime; strong separation is the main evidence the detector found something, unlike ARI which penalizes unavoidable lag.

nodes.label: GMM Detector
nodes.rationale: Unsupervised Gaussian mixture on standardized features; produces per-sample posterior with no temporal persistence.

nodes.label: HMM Detector
nodes.rationale: Full-covariance Gaussian HMM trained with EM (Baum-Welch) and forward-filtered only at prediction time; states sorted by volatility for comparable labels across refits.

nodes.label: HMM Local Optima Risk
nodes.rationale: Full-covariance HMM with light regularization can still find local optima; n_init restarts mitigate but do not eliminate this.

nodes.label: PyPI Trusted Publishing
nodes.rationale: GitHub Actions workflow builds, runs twine check and uploads via OIDC, avoiding a long-lived token in the repository.

nodes.label: Regime Feature Set
nodes.rationale: Features built from daily prices only (rv_5, rv_21, rv_63, vol_ratio, trend_21, trend_63, drawdown_63, corr_21) with no look-ahead; rv_21 is the reference for ordering regimes low to high volatility.

nodes.label: Toy Allocator
nodes.rationale: Maps state 0 to 100% equity, state 1 to 50%, state 2 to 0%, ignoring costs, cash yield and slippage; intended as a diagnostic, not a strategy.

nodes.label: uv
nodes.rationale: Project dependency manager; pyproject.toml declares dependencies and the console script while uv.lock pins the full resolution.

nodes.label: Vol Threshold Detector
nodes.rationale: Rule baseline using trailing-window quantiles of 21-day realized volatility; if ML models cannot beat it out-of-sample that is a finding, not a bug.

nodes.label: Walk-Forward Harness
nodes.rationale: Rolling refit / out-of-sample harness that every detector runs through, making model comparisons fair.

nodes.label: Economic Evaluation
nodes.rationale: "Regime" has no ground truth, so accuracy is mostly meaningless; what matters is whether regime-conditional allocations improve risk-adjusted return with acceptable turnover.

nodes.label: Filtered (Causal) Inference
nodes.rationale: Never use forward-backward-smoothed probabilities, which secretly use future data and make historical plots look excellent while live results fail.

nodes.label: Forward-Backward Smoothed Probabilities (Look-Ahead Trap)
nodes.rationale: Smoothed probabilities at time t incorporate observations after t; this is the central trap the pipeline is built to avoid.

nodes.label: Regime Persistence
nodes.rationale: A regime that flips every few days is not a regime; real volatility regimes persist for weeks to months, measured via share and avg_run_days.

nodes.label: Walk-Forward Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Refit on a trailing window and predict the next block out-of-sample, so reported performance is not contaminated by in-sample fitting.
